purpose: Teach: サンバ/ボビー/パトリック/クリストファー/リンダ/アーク/アナン/サドル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがサンバの音楽を聴かせて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad wants to play you some samba music.
lines.style: Warm, gently curious tone. Soft opening. Slight lift at the end — inviting his interest, not pushing. Patient pacing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとボビーの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a picture book with Dad about Bobby!
lines.style: Bright, immediate energy. Quick attack on the opening. Eager to share — words tumble out. Slight breathlessness from excitement. Genuine pride in the memory.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがパトリックの映画を観せて下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to show you a Patrick movie.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone. Slightly slower pace than before — savoring his delight. Soft delivery, almost conspiratorial, like sharing something special just for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとクリストファーの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I read a picture book with Dad about Christopher!
lines.style: Same bright energy as before but slightly more confident. Quick words, genuine enthusiasm. Subtle emphasis on the connection with Dad — that's what matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがリンダの曲を聴かせて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad is going to play you a Linda song.
lines.style: Soft, almost dreamy tone. Slower cadence — letting each word settle. Warm affection underneath. The faintest smile in the voice, enjoying the moment of telling him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとアーク門の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I changed the saddle on a bicycle with Dad!
lines.style: Quick, excited opening. Slightly higher register than previous lines — genuine accomplishment. Words flow fast. Confident finish, proud of the grown-up task he did with his father.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアナン事務総長のドキュメンタリーをご覧になったわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad watched a documentary about Secretary-General Annan.
lines.style: Gently reflective, almost conversational. Steady, unhurried pace. A touch of quiet amusement — she notices he's sharing things from his world with her. Warm and attentive listening quality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと自転車のサドル交換したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I changed the bike saddle with Dad today!
lines.style: Same eager brightness as his other lines, but with a slight deepening — he's genuinely proud, wants her to understand this mattered. Quick delivery, clear finish. Warmth in the voice.
